title: Cosmic Jellyfish Reaper
description: A vibrant purple cartoon jellyfish with large black eyes, a wide yellow smile and a tiny palm tree on its head floats in the center of a swirling cosmic vortex of yellow, orange, red and green light. To its right is a large cracked reddish-brown planet featuring a white skeleton dancing with smaller skeletons, set against a dark space background with floating orbs.
prompt: A whimsical purple cartoon jellyfish creature with big glossy black eyes, wide smiling mouth, green palm tree on its head, and dripping tentacles floats beside a cracked reddish planet that shows a dancing white skeleton. The jellyfish is surrounded by a dramatic swirling cosmic vortex of bright yellow, orange, red, and green light trails against a dark space background with floating translucent orbs, surreal fantasy style, vibrant and detailed digital painting.
